convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with unknown 'ColorStepXCCX' indicator and includes external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh). The ColorStepXCCX custom indicator logic is not available from built-in indicators, requiring manual Python reimplementation of the XCCX smoothing algorithm.

derived_values.name: MPlus - ColorStepXCCX buffer 0 (bullish step-momentum line)
derived_values.formula: ColorStepXCCX(DSmoothMethod=JJMA, DPeriod=30, DPhase=100, MSmoothMethod=T3, MPeriod=7, MPhase=15, IPC=PRICE_TYPICAL, StepSizeFast=5, StepSizeSlow=30)[SignalBar]

other_exits: Long position closed when MPlus crosses below MMinus (signal reversal) if BuyPosClose=true
Short position closed when MPlus crosses above MMinus (signal reversal) if SellPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If MM is negative, absolute value is used as fixed lot size; if positive, used as deposit fraction for lot calculation

custom_logic_notes: The ColorStepXCCX indicator is a stepped XCCX (X-plane Cycle Crossover) oscillator using two smoothing layers: price smoothing (JJMA with period 30, phase 100) and deviation smoothing (T3 with period 7, phase 15), then stepped with fast=5 and slow=30 step sizes. The crossover of two buffers (MPlus and MMinus) generates signals. Uses CIsNewBar class for new bar detection. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions with signal-time-based position management. The entry signal checks 2 bars: bar[1] (previous) for crossover condition and bar[0] (current relative to SignalBar) for pre-crossover state to confirm the crossover just occurred.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement the ColorStepXCCX indicator in Python. The indicator uses CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which provides JJMA, T3, and other advanced smoothing algorithms. These non-standard smoothers (JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) require porting from the .mqh library. The step-filter logic (StepSizeFast=5, StepSizeSlow=30) creates a staircase-like output from the smoothed CCI-style values. TradeAlgorithms.mqh position management functions need replacement with standard Python backtester position tracking. Entry logic: BUY when MPlus[1]>MMinus[1] AND MPlus[0]<=MMinus[0] (crossover confirmed); SELL when MPlus[1]<MMinus[1] AND MPlus[0]>=MMinus[0] (crossunder confirmed). The two-buffer crossover pattern is standard but the underlying indicator computation is complex.
